description: Matrix mixer, eight in and one out — each input into the mix through its own attenuverter

params.text: Knobs default to zero, so nothing is heard until some are turned up

inputs.text: One of the eight signals into the mix, at the level and polarity its own knob sets

outputs.text: Output soft-clips at 12V; hard clipping or none on the menu

notes: the knobs are attenuverters and start at zero, so nothing reaches the output until some are turned up
menu: Input gain — cuts every input before the mix: Unity, -3dB, -6dB or -12dB
Output clipping — Soft/saturated (better for audio) rounds the output off at 12V, Hard/clipped (better for CV) cuts it there and so sums CVs exactly, and None leaves it uncapped
Average — divides each output mix by the number of connected inputs instead of summing them
Indicator knobs — colours each knob green or orange to show its setting
Unipolar — each knob runs from zero to full over its whole travel and can no longer invert; the tick at noon then marks 50%
